title: Literal-safe JSON field probes across PowerShell
failure_signature: A multiply escaped JSON-field alternation reached ripgrep as an invalid unclosed group.
candidate_workaround: Use an exact file and a single-quoted regex or fixed-string query, then inspect the complete result independently.
recurrence_guard: Avoid layered backslash escaping for JSON key probes; validate one literal-safe pattern before combining search operations.
rollback: Retain the parser failure, make no repository inference from it, and rerun only after reducing the quoting layers.
scope_boundary: Search transport only; a successful field probe is not by itself a semantic novelty determination.
